metadata.title: Minneapolis Museums and Parks
metadata.description: Seven landmarks in Minneapolis, Minnesota, in two categories, used to show the separate roles of markers, popups and tile sources.
metadata.coordinates: Decimal degrees, latitude first. Approximate building or park centers.

markers.name: Walker Art Center
markers.description: A contemporary art museum beside the Minneapolis Sculpture Garden.

markers.name: Minneapolis Institute of Art
markers.description: An encyclopedic art museum in the Whittier neighborhood, south of downtown.

markers.name: Mill City Museum
markers.description: Built in the ruins of the Washburn A Mill on the Mississippi riverfront; tells the story of the city's flour-milling era.

markers.name: Weisman Art Museum
markers.description: The University of Minnesota's art museum, in a stainless-steel building by Frank Gehry on the east bank of the Mississippi.

markers.name: Boom Island Park
markers.description: A riverside park on the east bank of the Mississippi with views of the downtown skyline.

markers.name: Bde Maka Ska
markers.description: The largest lake in Minneapolis, ringed by walking and biking paths.

markers.name: Minnehaha Falls
markers.description: A waterfall on Minnehaha Creek in Minnehaha Regional Park, near where the creek meets the Mississippi.
